I'm sorry your item arrived damaged. Order 1008 was placed 45 days ago, and our refund window for paid orders is 30 days, so I can't request a refund for it through the standard process.

If you'd like, I can send your case to a human reviewer, who can look at damage claims. Just reply "escalate" and I'll pass along the details. You can also share photos of the damage so the reviewer has them.
